items.name: Telugu-Hand-written-OCR-based-System
items.description: A Telugu Handwritten OCR system using deep learning recognizes handwritten Telugu characters and converts them into digital text. It uses CNN models to learn strokes, curves, and shapes from images. The system includes preprocessing and character classification, helping in document digitization and Telugu language applications.

items.name: Telugu-Character-Recognition
items.description: Developed an end-to-end handwritten Telugu character recognition system using CNN. Built a custom dataset of 56 Telugu characters, implemented preprocessing with OpenCV, and achieved 98% accuracy using a CNN model designed with TensorFlow/Keras. Integrated segmentation and classification modules for real-world OCR applications.

items.name: -Automated-Paper-Correction-for-Telugu
items.description: Automated evaluation system for Telugu handwritten answers, designed to simplify and speed up the correction process. Currently supports text-based answer evaluation, with upcoming enhancements for image and video-based submissions using advanced processing techniques.

items.name: Handwritten-Character-Recognition
items.description: Developed a CNN-based Handwritten Character Recognition system for Indian languages (Telugu/Hindi), achieving 94% accuracy. Built a Flask web app for real-time predictions, enabling OCR and digitization of handwritten regional scripts for accessibility and education.

items.name: Multilingual-Handwritten-Prescription-Recognition-System
items.description: I build Multilingual Prescription Reader which is an AI-based system that extracts handwritten text from prescriptions in regional languages(Hindi,Telugu) using OCR. It then translates the text into English, making medical information easier to understand.

items.name: Final-Year-Capstone-Major-Project
items.description: Developed a YOLOv11-based system to detect and segment handwritten Telugu characters from images, videos, and webcam feeds. Built using Python, Anaconda, and Label Studio for dataset annotation, supporting Telugu OCR and document digitization.

items.name: HWR-with-Confidence-Calibration

items.name: indicpage-ocr
items.description: A lightweight OCR framework for digitizing handwritten pages in four Indic languages: Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, and Telugu. This repository provides code and models for page-level handwritten text recognition using efficient adaptation of vision-language models.

items.name: prescription-parser
